source: YouTube caption transcript 0:00-28:19 (cut-off 1699 s), card names corrected; nothing past 28:19 read. 'type' marks each idea as claim, heuristic or one-off pick. No idea restates an earlier idea one to one, so 'repeats' is empty throughout and shared topics are in 'related'; (idea 5aM-01 and mqZ ids are from other videos).

ideas.claim: Take the best card per 17Lands early in the draft, adjust for context later; the speakers put about 60% trust in the data.
ideas.quote: at the beginning of the draft, I tend to lean towards like the best card that the data might say is the best. And then after you go on, obviously you have to kind of adjust
ideas.test_idea: Compare pick-1..4 data-best agreement of strong drafters against later picks.

ideas.claim: Violent Echoes is a snap first pick over Draconic Visitor, a build-around that dies to removal.
ideas.quote: Draconic... is very good in every red deck for sure. Whereas draconic's more of a build around ... it's just kind of killable.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Violent Echoes vs Draconic Visitor by skill group.

ideas.claim: Rewrite Regrets is taken over Generous Revival and goes in any deck; blue is the worst cycler to pair it with, black and green are better.
ideas.quote: I think the blue cyclers the worst one to lock in for regrets. The black and the green are higher impact on regrets.
ideas.test_idea: Rewrite Regrets GIH WR by number and colour of basic landcyclers in the deck.

ideas.claim: Ranking of the cycle of basic landcyclers: white first, then red, then green and black, blue last; the best (white) is double white so not free.
ideas.quote: I think it's like white number one ... I think I'd go like white, red, and then like the green and black ones in there.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of each landcycler with the cycler in hand.

ideas.claim: Five-mana cards that need to untap (Draconic-style, Edgar) are rough because removal is good; the same effect at three or four mana is acceptable.
ideas.quote: at five that is rough. That's a tough sell.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of untap-to-win cards by cmc.

ideas.claim: Take the land over a playable (Keeper of the Quiet Hour, Transformative Commons) when the deck is three colours: you always find 23 playables.
ideas.quote: I think it's just you just always take the land unless it's like so above replacement. Like you're going to get 23.
ideas.test_idea: Within-deck value of a dual or tri land at picks 5-12 against the average playable it displaces.

ideas.claim: Three colours without a strict splash is fine in this format if picks go to lands and cyclers; the pods let you.
ideas.quote: you can just be three colors if you're willing to spend picks on lands and cyclers.
ideas.test_idea: Win rate of three-colour decks with 3+ fixing cards vs two-colour plus splash.

ideas.claim: Pia, Determined Rebuilder is one of the better creatures available in a non-creature deck and is taken over Pyre Rhymer; a creature is needed.
ideas.quote: we have a ton of not creatures, so maybe we just need a creature. And like Pia is one of the better creatures
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Pia, Determined Rebuilder against other UR three-drops.

ideas.claim: Geist of Saint Thalia is better than expected in a non-creature deck, but cap it at two copies.
ideas.quote: I'd play up to two Geists at most.
ideas.test_idea: Win rate of a second and third Geist in deck.

ideas.claim: Take a second Rewrite Regrets despite few cyclers, but three is too many; two is 'the perfect number'.
ideas.quote: three three would actually be a lot of rewrites anyways. I think two is like the perfect number.
ideas.test_idea: Marginal win rate of the second and third Rewrite Regrets by cycler count.

ideas.claim: With three landcyclers, play 16 lands 'almost every time'; with nine four-drops he keeps 17.
ideas.quote: I'm not playing 16 lands with nine four drops. That's crazy.
ideas.test_idea: Land count vs win rate with 2 and 3 landcyclers.

ideas.claim: An aggressive-card draft note: pitching a land to Tether Technician is not free in this format, so it is the worst Nekrataal; still a respectable body-plus-removal.
ideas.quote: pitching a land is not free in this format at all.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Tether Technician by land count.

ideas.claim: Keep an eight-source base for each main colour; the only worry is the lack of a third cycler for two Rewrite Regrets.
ideas.quote: having eight eight bases is always the goal and clearly we have more blue and red cards than black ones.
ideas.test_idea: Source counts of the main colours of winning three-colour decks.
